data.long_meaning: The name Aqsad is derived from the Arabic word ‘aqsadah’ which means ‘to demand’ or ‘to request’. In Islamic context, it is also associated with the concept of ‘Aqidah’ – the Islamic creed or belief system. Aqsad is a name that embodies the spiritual yearning and longing for the divine presence and guidance. The name Aqsad carries the meaning “Request, Demand, Wish” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aqsad usually hope their child will grow to embody request, demand, wish and live with faith, good character and purpose.
